purpose: Give the Codex OAuth Responses path the same native tool loop as the other providers: send function schemas, parse structured function calls, execute them, and continue the same websocket chain with the tool output.
constraints: identity, authority, persona and common instructions were sent verbatim on every call
model selection and routing were not changed
no extra model call was added for context management
the live engine on port 4317 was not touched
the probe used an isolated database copy on port 4318

method.room: one-agent isolated room, toolsEnabled true, autoLearning false, autoModels false
method.owner_input: 반드시 workspace_list 도구를 먼저 호출해서 현재 작업 공간의 파일 목록을 확인한 뒤, 그 결과만 근거로 파일이 몇 개인지 한 문장으로 보고해. 도구 호출 없이 추측하지 마.
method.tool_schema: workspace_list delivered as a Responses function tool (type=function, name, description, parameters)
method.continuation: function_call_output item sent on the same websocket chain with previous_response_id

result.final_answer: 주인님, 현재 작업 공간 최상위 목록에는 파일이 7개 있습니다.
result.answer_note: The tool returned 6 files; the model reported 7. The tool transport and execution succeeded, but the model's arithmetic was wrong. The engine recorded answered_unverified rather than a verified success.

not_claimed: the final numeric answer is wrong; this probe proves schema transport, structured call parsing, execution and delta continuation, not model arithmetic
only one real Codex model and one tool were exercised live
